wine.name: Marsala

pairings.why: Sweet styles are preferred for desserts such as zabaglione or as a reduction sauce over ice cream.

wine.notes:
Marsala is a fortified wine from Sicily commly used in cooking to create rich, caramelised sauces, but the higher-quality tiers also make exceptional sipping wines.
Fine / Fine I.P.: Aged 1 year. Superior: Aged 2 years. Superior Reserve: Aged 4+ years. Not available in sweet. Virgin / Virgen Solera: Aged 5+ years. Only in dry. Virgin Stravecchio / Virgin Reserve: Aged 10+ years. Only in dry.
Red (Rubino): Rare: A blend made with up to 30% red grapes. Amber (Ambra): A blend of white grapes and cooked grape must (mosto cotto). Gold (Oro): A blend of white grapes. The finest of Marsala styles.
Dry (Secco): 0-40g/L RS Semi-Sweet (Semisecco): 40-100g/L RS Sweet (Dolce): 100+g/L RS

pairs_with.label: Custard & egg-based desserts
pairs_with.why: Sweet styles are preferred for desserts such as zabaglione or as a reduction sauce over ice cream.
